title: 第13章 水泽滋生术灵种秘术已修改第14章 师尊风清草
content_zh:
“爷爷，小心！”李衍道的警告声刚刚落下，方圆便已决绝地利用体内最后一丝灵力，将其压缩在丹田之中，随即引发了自爆。
李松鹤反应迅速，立即操控天星龟释放出水幕作为防御，并将其挡在身前。
然而，这一切发生得太快，猝不及防之下，爆炸的力量仍然波及到了他。
“轰隆”一声巨响，爆炸的冲击波席卷了方圆十丈的范围。
李衍道同样受到了波及，幸好他及时施展了水盾术，再加上他处于爆炸的边缘地带，因此并未受到致命伤害。
“爷爷（爹）！”其他几位家族成员纷纷疾奔而来，心急如焚。
随着烟尘逐渐散去，一声“咳咳”的咳嗽声穿透了尘埃，传入众人的耳中，大家这才稍微松了一口气。
“还死不了！”李松鹤的声音传来，尽管气息有些虚弱，但依然充满力量。
他的身上多处受伤，鲜血直流，连年纪最小的李衍胜看到这一幕都不禁感到反胃。
李衍道用神识仔细检查了爷爷的伤势，发现都是一些皮肉伤，并无大碍，这才长长舒了一口气，心情放松下来。
然而，当他瞥见前方那只天星龟时，却不禁心头一紧——龟甲已经龟裂，露出了内部的白骨，显然已是奄奄一息。
“唉，可惜了我饲养了几十年的天星龟，这可是我在琉璃宗时就开始饲养的。”
李松鹤活动了一下筋骨，言语间流露出浓浓的惋惜之情。
一个时辰之后，即便有着李衍道那已达至圆满境界的水疗术倾力救治，那只天星龟依旧未能逃过命运的无常。
面对这一无可挽回的结局，李松鹤心怀敬意地带领着七位族人，在岛上为这只龟龟竖起了一方石碑。
碑上以深情的文字刻下了“爱龟之墓”四字。
天星龟的尸体，包括其珍贵的龟甲与肉质，便一同深埋于石碑之下。
然而，哀伤并未在此久久驻足。
在之前的激战中，他们斩杀了十数名练气期的修士，其中更有两位已达练气圆满之境。
这场对战可是有诸多战利品的。

夜幕降临，银辉倾泻在整个岛屿之上，岛上的轻风拂过，树叶沙沙作响。
李家众人则围坐在一座山峰的半山腰处，眼前摆放着从战斗中获得的各种资源，每个人的脸上都洋溢着难以掩饰的喜悦之情。
“爷爷，这里有两枚储物袋，我看它们内部的空间皆为一方丈大小，我可以得到其中一个吗？”李衍道带着几分期盼，率先开口问道。
李松鹤慈祥的目光扫过孙子的脸庞，温和地说道：“自然可以。
此次孙儿你在击退来犯之敌时表现英勇，立下大功，理应享有优先挑选战利品的权利。”
说罢，他便将一枚储物袋递给了李衍道。
李衍道双手接过储物袋，迫不及待地以神识探入其中。
当他感受到那小小储物袋内一方丈大小的空间时，内心的激动几乎难以言表。
这是他自踏入这片修仙世界以来所获得的第一件储物法宝。
在这片海域当中，储物法宝种类繁多，各具特色。
有小巧玲珑的储物贝，有储物手镯、储物珠，以及最为常见的储物袋。
而储物袋之所以广受欢迎，不仅仅是因为它的携带便捷，更在于其内部空间的稳定，非常适合练气期和筑基期的修士日常使用。
当然，储物袋的价值不菲，即便是散修之中，也只有达到炼气后期以上的修士，才有可能负担得起这样的储物宝贝。
李松鹤自从离开宗门，购置了风林岛之后，仅保留了一个储物袋。
这个储物袋对李家来说至关重要，每当需要运送灵米和灵鱼等珍贵资源时，都是由李松鹤亲自负责。
此刻，李松鹤的目光转向了剩下的那个储物袋，沉声道：“
剩余的这一个储物袋留给家族使用，专门用于装载灵米和灵鱼等资源。
今后，族人前往坊市交易时，便可以用此袋携带物品。”
接着，众人开始着手分配其他战利品。
一件上品法器飞剑与一柄中品法器圆盾，留给李松鹤与李衍道二人。

作为家族目前最强的战力，拥有这些高级法器的辅助，无疑能够大大增强他们在外出执行任务时的安全。
content_en:
"Grandpa, be careful!" As soon as Li Yandao's warning sounded, Fangyuan decisively used the last bit of spiritual power in his body to compress it in his dantian, and then triggered a self-destruction.
Li Songhe reacted quickly and immediately controlled the Star Turtle to release a water curtain as a defense and block it in front of him.
However, it all happened too fast, and he was caught off guard, and the force of the explosion still affected him.
There was a loud "boom", and the shock wave of the explosion swept across a radius of ten feet.
Li Yandao was also affected. Fortunately, he used the water shield technique in time, and he was on the edge of the explosion, so he was not fatally injured.
"Grandpa (Dad)!" Several other family members rushed over, anxious.
As the smoke gradually dispersed, a coughing sound penetrated the dust and reached everyone's ears, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
"You can't die yet!" Li Songhe's voice came. Although his breath was a little weak, it was still full of strength.
He had multiple injuries on his body and was bleeding profusely. Even the youngest Li Yansheng couldn't help but feel sick to his stomach when he saw this scene.
Li Yandao used his spiritual consciousness to carefully examine his grandfather's injuries and found that they were all flesh wounds, not serious. Then he breathed a long sigh of relief and relaxed.
However, when he caught a glimpse of the star tortoise in front of him, he couldn't help but feel nervous - the tortoise's shell had cracked, exposing the bones inside, and it was obviously dying.
"Alas, it's a pity that I have raised the Sky Star Turtle for decades. I started raising it when I was in the Liuli Sect."
Li Songhe flexed his muscles and expressed deep regret in his words.
An hour later, even with Li Yandao's perfect hydrotherapy skills, he still could not escape the uncertainty of fate.
Faced with this irreversible outcome, Li Songhe respectfully led seven tribesmen and erected a stone monument for the turtle on the island.
The four words "Tomb of Love Turtle" are engraved in affectionate words on the monument.
The star tortoise's body, including its precious tortoise shell and flesh, was buried deep under the stone monument.
However, the sadness did not stay here for long.
In the previous fierce battle, they killed more than a dozen monks who were in the Qi training stage, and two of them had reached the stage of perfect Qi training.
There is a lot of loot in this battle.
As night falls, the silver glow pours over the entire island. The breeze blows on the island and the leaves rustle.
Everyone in the Li family was sitting around halfway up a mountain. Various resources obtained from the battle were placed in front of them. Everyone's face was filled with unconcealable joy.
"Grandpa, there are two storage bags here. I see that the space inside them is about one foot in size. Can I get one of them?" Li Yandao asked first with some expectation.
Li Songhe glanced at his grandson's face with kind eyes and said gently: "Of course you can.
This time, my grandson, you performed bravely and made great achievements in repelling the invading enemies. You should have the first right to select the spoils. "
After saying that, he handed a storage bag to Li Yandao.
Li Yandao took the storage bag with both hands and couldn't wait to explore it with his spiritual consciousness.
When he felt the one-foot-sized space inside the small storage bag, his inner excitement was almost indescribable.
This is the first storage magic weapon he has obtained since he entered this world of cultivating immortals.
In this sea area, there are many types of storage magic weapons, each with its own characteristics.
There are small and exquisite storage shells, storage bracelets, storage beads, and the most common storage bags.
The reason why the storage bag is so popular is not only because it is easy to carry, but also because of the stability of its internal space, which is very suitable for daily use by monks in the Qi training and foundation building stages.
Of course, the storage bag is valuable. Even among casual cultivators, only those who have reached the late stage of Qi refining or above can bear the burden.I can afford such a storage treasure.
Since Li Songhe left the sect and purchased Fenglin Island, he only kept one storage bag.
This storage bag is very important to the Li family. Whenever precious resources such as spiritual rice and spiritual fish need to be transported, Li Songhe is personally responsible for it.
At this moment, Li Songhe turned his eyes to the remaining storage bag and said in a deep voice: "
The remaining storage bag is reserved for the family and is specially used to carry resources such as spiritual rice and spiritual fish.
From now on, tribesmen can use this bag to carry items when they go to the market for transactions. "
Then, everyone began to distribute other spoils.
A high-grade magic weapon, a flying sword, and a medium-grade magic weapon, a round shield, were left to Li Songhe and Li Yandao.
As the family's strongest combat force at present, having the assistance of these high-level magic weapons can undoubtedly greatly enhance their safety when they go out to perform missions.
